rows.note: This is the all-purpose word for a condiment or sauce served with food.

example.english: This fried fish needs some sauce to taste good.
example.traditional: 呢碟煎魚要點醬先好食。
example.jyutping: nei1 dip6 zin1 jyu4 jiu3 dim2 zoeng3 sin1 hou2 sik6

rows.note: Use this specifically for tomato sauce or ketchup rather than the general word for sauce.

example.english: Kids always want tomato sauce on their fries.
example.traditional: 細路食薯條一定要落茄汁。
example.jyutping: sai3 lou6 sik6 syu4 tiu4 jat1 ding6 jiu3 lok6 ke4 zap1

rows.note: Use this when “sauce” is slang for alcohol or booze.

example.english: Let’s go out for some sauce tonight.
example.jyutping: gam1 maan5 jat1 cai4 heoi3 jam2 zau2 laa1
